body.author: Vasilios Venegas
body.text: Analysis clarification recorded after all classical runs finished and before any write-up: the primary outcome is defined against a recorded reference value, so the 10 cyclic-code calibration problems with no recorded reference (n=6..15) are excluded from success rates rather than counted as failures. For an exploratory comparison only, general stabilizer-code optima for [[n,1,d]], n=6..15, were retrieved from codetables.de on 2026-11-01 and stored as post_hoc_reference in the problem specs. They are never used in the pre-registered analysis.

body.author: Vasilios Venegas
body.text: Independent cross-check: scripts/crosscheck_cyclic.py enumerated every seed without symmetry reduction for n=6..11 and found best distances 2,3,3,3,4,3, identical to the symmetry-reduced exhaustive arm.
